AUTHOR: Li
TITLE: Fish Trajectory Extraction Based on Object Detection
VENUE: PROCEEDINGS OF THE 39TH CHINESE CONTROL CONFERENCE
REGION: USA hydropower sites (Wells Dam, Voith Hydro, Igiugig) per MHK dataset
DATA: MHK underwater fish dataset (Xu & Matzner 2018), three scenes; Wells Dam fish-passage viewing-window test video (150 frames)
D_EV: Sec 4.1: 'a Faster RCNN model was trained with the training set of all three scenes' / 'Another Faster RCNN model was trained with only the Wells Dam training set' - split unit not stated
R_EV: Sec 4.1: 'The performance of the model on MHK test set is shown in Table 1' - single dataset only
C_EV: Sec 3.3/4.3: score_threshold=0.5; 'Linking connects short trajectory segments to a long trajectory. Deleting discards short trajectories' (55->22->15 trajectories)
E_EV: Sec 4.2: 'The AP performance is used as the criterion' - only detection AP reported for trajectories
ARCH: Faster R-CNN ResNet50-FPN + IoU/center-distance/probability association (greedy/Hungarian), linking & deleting
NOTE: MHK dataset = PNNL water-power fish videos (field deployments incl. Wells Dam fish passage window) -> treated as field monitoring dataset. Headline AP 74.75->80.94 on 150 frames of one Wells Dam test video. C5 coded for trajectory linking (track merging) and deletion of short false tracks; verify. Trajectories motivated by behavior/aquaculture but no behavior analysis -> E1 none. DSHR: public dataset used.
AUTHORS_FULL: Li, XH; Liu, MQ; Zhang, SL; Zheng, RH
